title: The Quick reply from the office
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：quick　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 quick 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the foreman wrote of ① a quick reply from the office in the sheet, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② quicker than the one named there the year before. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the foreman, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the quick ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the quickest reply from the office anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the sheet for May 1979 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too quick to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the quick ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a quick mind of the boy, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as quick as the mind of the boy they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was quick or not, and he said so.

By 1992 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the sheet. What the line asked for was ⑦ something quick, and nothing besides. The worker from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite quick; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the sheet kept the names of the quick ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1995, in silence, she wrote of another quick reply from the office in the same sheet, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ quicker than anybody had expected. ⑩ The quickest mind of the boy in the whole site, she said in 1997, was the one she could never quite name; the quick ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 迅速（前置定语 a quick reply from the office：1985 年工头在施工单里记下的那件迅速的回复）
B. adj. 迅速／敏捷（比较级 quicker than：文中两处，一处比办公室迅速的回复，一处比预想）
C. adj. 迅速／敏捷（最高级 the quickest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 迅速（表语 too quick to do：母亲觉得它太迅速，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 敏捷（前置定语 a quick mind of the boy：叔叔把整件事称作一桩敏捷的头脑）
F. adj. 敏捷（同级比较 as quick as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩男孩敏捷的头脑相比）
G. adj. 敏捷（后置定语 something quick：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 敏捷（受程度副词修饰 quite quick：那位工人的评价）

items.q: a quick reply from the office
the quickest reply from the office anybody
a quick mind of the boy
The quickest mind of the boy in

answers.why: quick 意为“迅速”，1985 年工头在施工单里记下的是“一件迅速的回复”，此处作前置定语 a quick reply from the office。
quick 意为“迅速”，此处用比较级 quicker than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
quick 意为“迅速”，施工单上 五月 那行字说它是工地里最迅速的一件，故用最高级 the quickest reply from the office。
quick 意为“迅速”，母亲认为这件东西“太迅速了，谁也用不上”，too quick to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
quick 意为“敏捷”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩敏捷的头脑”，此处作前置定语 a quick mind of the boy。
quick 意为“敏捷”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩男孩敏捷的头脑一样敏捷”，同级比较用 as quick as。
quick 意为“敏捷”，施工单上那半行字要的是“敏捷的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something quick。
quick 意为“敏捷”，邻工地来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当敏捷”，quite 修饰原级 quick。
quick 意为“敏捷”，1995 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要敏捷”，故用比较级 quicker than。
quick 意为“敏捷”，母亲 1997 年说的是“整个工地里最敏捷的那一桩”，故用最高级 the quickest mind of the boy。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1985 年，工头在施工单里记下了一件迅速的回复。（a quick reply from the office）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更迅速。（quicker than …）
母亲觉得它太迅速，谁也用不上。（too quick to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩敏捷的头脑。（a quick mind of the boy）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩男孩敏捷的头脑一样敏捷。（as quick as …）
到了 1992 年，施工单上只剩半行字：要的是一件敏捷的东西。（something quick）
answers: In 1985 the foreman wrote of a quick reply from the office in the sheet.
Everybody said it was quicker than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too quick to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a quick mind of the boy.
He said nobody would call it as quick as the mind of the boy they had once had.
By 1992 the sheet asked for nothing but something quick.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 quick 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1985 the foreman wrote of a quick reply from the office in the sheet, and nobody forgot it.
It was the quickest reply from the office in the site, or so the sheet says.
My mother thought it too quick to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a quick mind of the boy, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next site called the plan quite quick, and everybody laughed.
The quick ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
